schedule.trip_association_method: Sort route schedule by unique MPL4 arrival time; sort each stop schedule by time; associate by rank. All 13 stop lists contain 63 unique times; all 63 MPL4 anchors match exactly; all joined stop times are nondecreasing. This is a derived association because stop endpoints omit trip_id.
schedule.morning_selection: 08:00 <= scheduled ARS3 arrival < 09:00; 5 departures; includes downstream arrivals after09:00
schedule.calendar_caveat: services API selected_date20261028 resolves active service. Nested route service_days all false and dates null; do not interpret as no service. Current full calendar_dates export not verified.
schedule.intermediate_timepoint_caveat: Only MPL4 is listed as timing point within this segment. Non-timingpoint seconds are operator scheduled references; interpolation algorithm and current raw GTFS timepoint0 values not exposed by inspected API.

observations.historical_availability_status: not verified; false here means no archive obtained in this research, not proof of nonexistence
observations.stcp_vehicle_timestamp_caveat: Per-vehicle timestamp/vehicle_id null in inspected STCP API; top-level timestamp is response-generation timestamp. Broker observationDateTime and stable fleetVehicleId are preferable for collector quality checks.
observations.arrival_prediction_caveat: Stop realtime endpoint returns estimated arrivals and delay_minutes; scheduled_arrival_time is null in samples. Predictions are not actual stop passages; identical delay value at multiple stops does not localize delay.

limitations: Not a current validated traffic model or private-car access policy
No historical morning bus or traffic-count series acquired
Current per-trip shapes/GTFS shape_id not exposed by inspected route shape endpoint
No completeness, update-rate or uptime guarantee verified for public APIs

mapping_note: Shape-constrained bus route through current official stop sequence; mapped geometry is not field-validated.
